headings: Vetting Your Designs Ahead of Launch
core_concepts: Vetting Your Designs Ahead of Launch Although we are focusing on A/B testing in this book, remember that throughout your design process you might use other forms of data to inform how you craft your experience
You can also use these methods and tools to evaluate your designs well ahead of launching them in an A/B test; you might find that you are able to eliminate a test cell or two before launch

We’ll give you a quick survey (no pun intended!) of a few of the tools you might consider using
